This CVE is a CPU exhaustion DoS in zlib's crc32_combine64 and crc32_combine_gen64 functions, which combine CRC values from separately compressed streams. WordPress uses zlib for standard HTTP gzip compression and zip file handling via inflate/deflate APIs, not the specialized crc32_combine functions. The vulnerable code path is not exercised.

This CVE is a memory leak in the xmllint interactive shell. The WordPress image only includes the libxml2 shared library, not the xmllint binary (provided by libxml2-utils). The vulnerable code is not present in the image.
